question: Which sector was given the main emphasis in the second Five-Year Plan?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Industry__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Industry sector** was given the main emphasis in the **second Five-Year Plan**.
 
• A part of the economy known as the industrial sector is made up of companies that help other companies with the **production, transportation, or manufacture of their goods.**
 
• Because the industrial sector sells its goods and services to other companies rather than to customers directly, it is referred to as a **secondary sector.**
 
• Due to its dependence on purchasing from **companies** in other sectors, the** industrial sector** is frequently driven by changes in **supply and demand** in other sectors.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Second Five-Year Plan**

 
 
• ​**April 1956 through March 1961 are included in the Second Five-Year Plan.**
 
• The second strategy involved setting India up for industrialization.
 
• The **architect** of the second five-year plan was **P.C. Mahalanobis.**
 
• He gave the industrial foundation of the economy the most attention.
 
• In light of this, the **1948 Industrial Policy Resolution** was revised, and a new resolution was adopted in 1956.
